# Patient routing boundary

This contour explains ownership between the personal expert platform and existing patient systems.

The first personal-brand patient product is **RAIM SMILE Second Opinion**. Its product authority remains `docs/raimov/patient-funnel/RAIM_SMILE_SECOND_OPINION_PRODUCT.md`; operator portability, CRM, consent and clinical handoff remain governed by existing RAIM SMILE SSOT/contracts.

Personal-brand content may route a qualified patient into Second Opinion, but cannot promise personal treatment by Atabek, bypass the disclosed licensed operator, merge medical records into marketing CRM or rewrite BALAM/SmileCare 12 routes.
